showDescription.en:
Hey everyone! We’re Serena & Betty.
Welcome aboard The Memory Express! 🚄
In this podcast, we keep it 100% real—no filter, no holding back. Life is full of wild, absurd moments, and honestly... how do we always find ourselves in such ridiculous messes?
After being friends for over a decade, we realized we’ve let way too many unforgettable, miraculous moments slip by unrecorded. So, we decided to fire up this train and document it all!
Grab a seat and hop on the ride with us :D
(All aboard—it’s story time!)
Slightly More Direct & Polished
Hi everyone, we’re Min & Patty!
Welcome to The Life Train, a podcast where nothing is off-limits. Life is full of surprises—and plenty of crazy, chaotic moments that leave us asking: “What just happened?”
Having known each other for more than ten years, we’ve missed capturing so many everyday miracles. Now, we’re steering this train forward to record them all.
Come ride along with us! :D
(Hop on and listen in~)
